lines.en: He's awful!
Listen to the tape then answer this question.
lines.cn: 先听这段录音，然后再回答这个问题。

lines.en: How did Pauline answer the telephone at nine o'clock?
lines.cn: 保罗琳在九点钟是如何接电话的？

lines.en: What's Ron Marston like, Pauline?
lines.cn: 罗恩·马斯顿是个怎么样的人啊，保琳？

lines.en: He's awful!
He telephoned me four times yesterday and three times the day before yesterday.
lines.cn: 他昨天给我打了四次电话，前天则打了三次电话。

lines.en: He telephoned the office yesterday morning and yesterday afternoon.
lines.cn: 他昨天上午和昨天下午都给办公室打了电话。

lines.en: My boss answered the telephone.
What did your boss say to him?
lines.cn: 你的老板对他说了什么？

lines.en: He said, 'Pauline is typing letters.
She can't speak to you now!'
Then I arrived home at six o'clock yesterday evening.
lines.cn: 然后我昨天晚上六点钟回到了家。

lines.en: He telephoned again.
But I didn't answer the phone!
Did he telephone again last night?
lines.cn: 他昨晚又打电话来了吗？

lines.en: Yes, he did.
He telephoned at nine o'clock.
lines.cn: 他是在九点钟打来的电话。

lines.en: What did you say to him?
I said, 'This is Pauline's mother.
Please don't telephone my daughter again!'
lines.cn: “请不要再给我女儿打电话了！”

lines.en: Did he telephone again?
No, he didn't!
